precondition: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200). An Administrator account holding AdminUsers and a Secretary account without it, supplied by QA lead; the three built-in roles ("Thành viên", "Phê duyệt viên", "Quản trị viên") and a few custom roles; some audit-log entries written by earlier actions.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/roles lists every role with its account count, built-in roles first.
procedure: Sign in as the Administrator (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send GET /api/roles with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.
expected: HTTP 200 OK.
Body: an array; each item has { "id", "name", "description", "isBuiltIn", "isDefault", "userCount" } and no "capabilities".
The order is "Thành viên", "Phê duyệt viên", "Quản trị viên", then custom roles by creation time.
Exactly one role has "isDefault": true ("Thành viên"); "userCount" counts accounts holding the role, deactivated ones included.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Administrator account holding AdminUsers, supplied by QA lead.
A custom role "Trợ lý thu giọng" with no accounts, created through POST /api/roles.
